defects: Historical Coalition, Greens and Other/Independent labels were not mapped to LIB_NAT, GRN and OTH_IND, so local vectors collapsed toward a common composition.
Assembly seat means summed district wins across simulations rather than averaging per-simulation chamber vectors.

certification: The score is valid evidence of the code that ran, but is non-certifying for the intended complete seat-level architecture. It must not be relabelled as a corrected-model result.
